_comment: Reading-list eval set: questions whose right answer is a SHELF, not a passage. One JSON object per line, the same shape scripts/eval already reads. findBooks was tuned on four questions somebody typed by hand and had nothing to measure against; this is that measurement. `expectedWorks` are books that plainly belong - matched by leading substring of the title, so the set survives a re-ingest and a corrected title. `expectAll` asks how much of the shelf was found rather than whether anything was. A question with no expectations at all is a control: the library holds nothing on it and the right answer is to say so. Run with `make listeval`.

question: Books about Docker
alsoAcceptable: Hands-On Docker for Microservices with Python
Continuous Delivery with Docker and Jenkins
notes: nine books carry the docker tag; four of them say it in the title; intent left unlabelled: this routes to find-book rather than broad-topic and both are legitimate answers to "give me a shelf" - what is scored is the shelf
